waypy.screen.title: Waypy
waypy.render.label: %s (%sm)
waypy.gui.undo.blocked: Can't restore "%s": its blocks now belong to another waypoint
waypy.gui.delete.group_tooltip: Delete removes waypoints only. Use Ungroup in the editor to dissolve a group
waypy.gui.delete.multi_tooltip: Select a single waypoint to delete it
waypy.gui.selected_hint: Ctrl+click toggles a waypoint, Shift+click selects a range
waypy.gui.make_group.tooltip: Group the selected waypoints. Far away, a group is shown as one pin
waypy.gui.make_group.mixed: All waypoints of a group must be in the same dimension
waypy.gui.ungroup.tooltip: Dissolve the group. Its waypoints stay as normal waypoints
waypy.gui.remove_from_group.tooltip: Take this waypoint out of the group (a group needs at least 2 waypoints)
waypy.gui.create_layout.tooltip: Save this group's arrangement as a layout, anchored on the block you stand on. Place it from the Layouts tab of the Presets popup (%s)
waypy.gui.create_layout.no_block: Stand on a block to create a layout: that block becomes its anchor
waypy.gui.create_layout.other_dimension: Go to this group's dimension to create a layout
waypy.gui.name: Name
waypy.gui.position.overlap: Can't move here: it would overlap waypoint "%s"
waypy.gui.position.clamped: Y is limited to the build height (%s to %s)
waypy.gui.visible.group_tooltip: Hide or show the whole group: its waypoints and its group pin. The waypoints' own Visible settings are kept
waypy.gui.show_text.tooltip: Show the name and distance under the logo (if the Labels setting allows it)
waypy.gui.show_text.group_tooltip: Show the group's name, waypoint count and distance on its pin (if the Labels setting allows it)
waypy.gui.block_picker.title: Choose Block
waypy.presets.title: Presets
waypy.presets.empty: No presets yet – press + to create one
waypy.presets.button.tooltip: Click or press %s to apply. Right-click to edit
waypy.presets.button.tooltip.no_key: Click to apply. Right-click to edit
waypy.presets.form.shared: Presets are shared by all worlds
waypy.presets.delete.tooltip: Delete this preset. The ones after it move up a number
waypy.popup.tab.tooltip: Ctrl+Tab switches between Presets and Layouts
waypy.layouts.empty: No layouts yet – right-click a group in the menu (%s) to create one
waypy.layouts.new.tooltip: Right-click a group in the menu (%s) to create a layout
waypy.layouts.button.tooltip: %s waypoints, %s blocks. Click or press %s to place it here. Right-click to rename or delete
waypy.layouts.button.tooltip.no_key: %s waypoints, %s blocks. Click to place it here. Right-click to rename or delete
waypy.layouts.form.shared: Layouts are shared by all worlds
waypy.layouts.delete.tooltip: Delete this layout. The ones after it move up a number
waypy.settings.title: Waypy Settings
waypy.settings.render_distance.tooltip: Beacon beams and block highlights farther away than this are not drawn. The logo and label are always shown.
waypy.settings.icon_size.tooltip: Size of the waypoint logos and labels.
waypy.settings.shrink.tooltip: Markers get smaller with distance, like real objects: full size up to 16 blocks, half size at 32, never smaller than 35%. Labels never get smaller than 50%.
waypy.settings.labels.always.tooltip: Show the label of every waypoint. Where labels overlap, the nearest waypoint's label is shown.
waypy.settings.labels.looking_at.tooltip: Only show the label of the waypoint you are looking at.
waypy.settings.show_distance.tooltip: Show the distance in meters after the waypoint name.
waypy.settings.group_combine_distance.to: Applies to all groups: farther away than this, a group is shown as one pin instead of its waypoints.
waypy.settings.show_waypoints.tooltip: OFF hides everything Waypy draws (beams, highlights and pins), like the Hide/Show All Waypoints key (%s). The menu and the create key still work.
waypy.settings.h_opens.tooltip: The tab the Open Presets key (%s) opens the popup on. The Open Layouts key (unbound by default) always opens Layouts.
